settings.title: Free Raffia Bag Giveaway (English only)

settings.title: Goddess Collection Instagram Giveaway 2025 - T&Cs (English only)
settings.answer:
Promotion Period:
THE FUTURE ROCKS (“TFR”) Goddess Collection Instagram Giveaway 2025 starts on January 14th, 2025, at 05:00 AM Eastern Standard Time (“EST”), and ends on January 24th, 2025, at 11:59 PM EST (the "Giveaway Period").

Eligibility:
To participate in the giveaway, participants must complete the following steps within the Giveaway Period:

  • Like the giveaway post.
  • Follow @thefuture.rocks or @thefuture.rocks.jp ( “TFR official Instagram accounts”) Instagram account.
  • Tag a friend in the comment OR
  • Comment on the post with your favorite mix-and-match or stacking combination from Design Lab’s The Goddess Collection (“The Goddess Collection”).

Giveaway prize:

A 20USD / 150HKD cash coupon code to purchase The Goddess collection products from THE FUTURE ROCKS at https://thefuturerocks.com or https://hk.thefuturerocks.com (“TFR official websites”) subject to the promotion's terms and conditions (the "Terms and Conditions").

Terms and Conditions:

  • The promo code will be sent to eligible participants via Instagram Direct Message.
  • The promo code is valid from January 14th, 2025, at 05:00 AM EST until February 15th, 2025, at 11:59 PM EST (“Promotion period”).
  • The promo code is only valid for online purchases of items under The Goddess Collection on TFR official websites, while stocks last.
  • To redeem, enter the promo code under "Discount code" at checkout.
  • The price used to calculate the promotion discount amount applied to your order will be the price displayed at the time of purchase.
  • The promo code cannot be used to purchase gift vouchers or cards.
  • The promo code is non-exchangeable, and no cash alternative is offered.
  • The promo code cannot be used in conjunction with other promotional offers.
  • The promo code does not apply to shipping charges associated with your order.
  • Only one promo code can be used per transaction.
  • Returns are subject to THE FUTURE ROCKS’ Return & Refund Policy. If you return or seek a refund on any item purchased using the promo code, the value of the discount will not be refunded to you.
  • The Future Rocks Company Limited reserves the right to modify the Terms and Conditions at any time without notice.
  • The Future Rocks Company Limited reserves the right to the final decision.
  • For any inquiries regarding this promotion, please contact us at contact@thefuturerocks.com
